threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think 'getting the 38' means hailing a cab. Everyone here knows it’s all about the bus stop and a good playlist.
Sat next to a couple on the N29 last night, arguing about their pet parakeet’s diet. Meanwhile, the driver had to stop for a pigeon in the middle of the road.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I heard a group of kids organizing a spontaneous street soccer match, complete with homemade goals and a cheering crowd. That's Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: In Kreuzberg, it's common to spot a group of people enjoying a spontaneous dance party right on the street, with a portable speaker and quirky costumes. Only in Berlin!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know a true local when they find the one taco truck that still serves good burritos after midnight, while visitors are stuck at the tourist traps.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Spotted a dog casually lounging on the Muni tracks at Civic Center yesterday. The driver just sighed and waited. Classic San Francisco moment.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think the Gràcia festival is just a party. It’s a whole neighborhood's heartbeat, a blend of tradition and an explosion of creativity, not just 'cute decorations.'

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You’ll notice them struggling with the 'x' in 'cerca de'—they say it like it’s written instead of blending it into the flow.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You keep staring at the bus schedule, waiting for a train, not realising you just have to hop on the 38 to get anywhere in Dalston.
Last night on the 59, a guy serenaded the whole bus with an off-key rendition of 'Wonderwall'—even got a round of applause at Brixton Station.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: It hit me when I heard the spontaneous dance party in the park while the buses were on strike. Only here do people turn a delay into a celebration.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a flea market where you can trade your old vinyl for homemade hummus. No cash needed, just good vibes.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by their utter frustration with Muni delays, especially when it’s always a dog on the tracks causing chaos. Classic SF.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a suit reading Shakespeare on the 19 while a street musician belted out blues. Only in SF does chaos feel like art.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can just order a ‘café con leche’ at any hour. Local wisdom? It’s a morning drink, after 12, stick with a ‘cortado’.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They often stand staring at the map on Carrer del Bisbe, oblivious to the locals weaving around them with purpose.
